facts: Nikola develops heavy-duty fast-fueling hydrogen vehicles with an estimated range of 500-750 miles.
Nikola hydrogen fueling stations are standardized to fill in less than 15 minutes.
Nikola was awarded a $1.7 million U.S. Department of Energy award published on August 7, 2019.
Hydrogen fuel cells have been powering space shuttles since the early 1960s.
Hydrogen is 14 times more buoyant than air and dissipates more rapidly than other fuels.
Nikola is an active member of international standards communities including ISO, GTR, and SAE.
